name: 2026-midterms-backend
description: Backend API for 2026 Federal Midterm Elections information

scripts.build: prisma generate && npm run prisma:generate:polls && tsc
scripts.prisma:deploy: prisma migrate deploy && npm run prisma:deploy:polls
scripts.prisma:deploy:polls: if [ -n "$POLLS_DATABASE_URL" ]; then prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/polls/schema.prisma; else echo 'POLLS_DATABASE_URL is not set; skipping the polls database migrations'; fi
